static_traits.name: Li Mingxuan
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone, distant relationship with parents
static_traits.social_status: Has several friends to rely on, but unwilling to trouble them with personal distress
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem experiences yet; has not yet received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I am a terrible Athlete; after the mistake of not catching the ball while playing volleyball, Self-doubt and low self-worth appeared, and these feelings persist, accompanied by self-criticism and negative self-talk when doing sports activities.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because these feelings of inadequacy are affecting my self-esteem and confidence, not only in sports but also in other aspects of life.
growth_experiences: The mistake of not catching the ball while playing volleyball a week ago. The client values athletic ability highly; feeling embarrassed about the performance, developing Self-doubt and low self-worth; since then, continuous self-criticism and negative self-talk when doing sports activities, fear of failure hindering attempts to improve skills.

Last month, on a day with high Work stress, overcooking the steak, subsequently forming the view of 'being a terrible Chef' and starting to avoid cooking. The intimate time originally spent cooking together with daughter thus reduced, and the client feels guilt and Depression over losing these moments; although trying to watch cooking tutorial videos, still feeling 'I will never get better'.

special_situations.event: The mistake of not catching the ball while playing volleyball, and feeling embarrassed about it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make mistakes in sports, it means I am a terrible Athlete, and not worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to improve athletic skills, but Withdrawing or stagnating when participating in sports activities due to fear of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a terrible Athlete, I have embarrassed myself

special_situations.event: Overcooked the steak on a very stressful day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If cooking goes wrong, it means I am a terrible Chef, and will disappoint daughter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding cooking; watching tutorial videos but still not cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never get better, my cooking will just fail

special_situations.event: At every dinner time or Thinking about having to cook
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail again, it will prove I am not good enough, and harm the relationship with daughter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: By Avoiding cooking to avoid failure and shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Tonight will be messed up again, better not to do it

special_situations.event: When recalling cooking experiences, only focusing on that steak failure while ignoring successful breakfasts or lunches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only big failures matter, success does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuous Self-denial, downplaying or excluding positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those successes are not worth mentioning

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as capable (in sports and cooking), and maintaining intimate shared activities with daughter
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being humiliated by failure, being evaluated, fearing disappointing important others (such as daughter)
defense_goal: Through avoidance and self-criticism, reduces the risk of failure, maintaining a sense of security and the remnants of self-worth

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, oneself who will fail and disappoint daughter
object_relations.object_representation: Others (including daughter) are judgmental and disappointed onlookers

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to acknowledge and attend to successful experiences and give herself positive affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to understand attending to success as downplaying 'real failure', worrying this amounts to self-deception and ignoring the problem
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a hesitant, cautious tone, repeatedly emphasizing the seriousness of failure, using words such as 'but/actually' to downplay success; avoiding directly acknowledging positive experiences.

manifestations: Lives alone, distant relationship with parents
Unwilling to trouble friends with personal distress
Avoiding shared cooking time with daughter

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulses they want to act out toward others or the outside world, and instead directs the energy toward themselves (such as self-blame and self-attack), corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Avoids cooking and turns frustration into self-criticism
After a sports mistake, repeatedly blames himself rather than seeking help or reviewing through practice

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Expressing cautiously in counseling with frequent Self-denial
Worrying about bothering friends and not seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: When cooking (especially dinner), the client usually feels Anxiety recalling the steak failure and chooses to Avoid cooking, leading to reduced time cooking together with daughter.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In some breakfast or lunch situations, the client can successfully make decent meals, and no longer avoids as before; this improved confidence and experience in the moment.
exception_events.reason: Cues: the task was less difficult and the pressure lower (not a high-pressure after-work moment), and the dish was simpler and more controllable, so that time it was easier to focus and complete.

positive_force: Willing to try new approaches and accept counseling
Has had successful breakfast or lunch experiences, with some cooking foundation
Valuing the relationship with daughter and hoping to Recovery shared activities
Proactively watching tutorial videos to improve skills
negative_force: Fearing failure and predicting negative outcomes
Tends to ignore positive experiences, focusing only on mistakes
Labeling and black-and-white thinking damage self-worth
Living alone with Distant relationships with parents, low Social support utilization

target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing one failure, worrying that failing again will disappoint daughter and embarrass oneself
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and shame, briefly relieving Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced interaction with daughter and feeling guilt, Anxiety and self-doubt worsen, Decreased self-confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Self-criticism and negative self-talk in sports contexts
antecedent: Participating in or thinking about sports activities
Comparing with others and feeling embarrassed
target_behavior.core_reason: Labeling and black-and-white thinking, equating one mistake with 'I am a terrible Athlete'
target_behavior.function: Gaining a sense of control or preempting external criticism through self-punishment and inner criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced participation in sports, performance further impaired, self-esteem and Decreased confidence
